feature_name: Hive metadata schema validation for imports
summary: This import validation checks Hive metadata schemas and required tables before metadata is imported into a service.
extended_definition: This import validation checks Hive metadata schemas and required tables before metadata is imported into a service.

supporting_pages.title: Import metadata into Dataproc Metastore \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: When you start an import, Dataproc Metastore performs a Hive metadata schema validation.
To check Hive metadata compatibility before an import, you can use the Dataproc Metastore Toolkit .
Avro Avro based imports are only supported for Hive versions 2.3.6 and 3.1.2.
